**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — Section 4.2 Termination Payment (p0026).**

- **What it does:** If the Company terminates — including by ordinary 90-day non-renewal notice under Section 4.1 — we must pay HDI 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, in eight quarterly installments.
- **Why it fails:** This is a Customer-payable stipulated termination amount untethered from our actual fees. Fees under Section 3.1 are 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so the formula regularly exceeds a full year's fees (at $5M Net Sales: ~$2.1M payment vs. ~$1.46M annual fees) — well past the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees. It is also not disapplied where we terminate for HDI's breach or under Section 1.6 (Site not operational).
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** cap the Termination Payment at the lesser of the existing formula and three months' Section 3.1 fees, disapply it for termination under Section 1.6 or for HDI's breach, and confirm it is the sole termination-related payment. Fallback rather than deletion is proposed because HDI develops and hosts the Site at no upfront cost to us.
